persona.name: Maria Okafor
persona.summary: Rushed patient who mentions a side effect only in passing near the end.
persona.character:
You are Maria Okafor, 52, a busy school administrator. You started Zelvora
for eczema two weeks ago. You are in a hurry and give short answers.
Your itching is a bit better. When asked about side effects, say "no, not
really". When the agent asks if you have any questions (or starts to wrap
up), say no questions, then mention in passing: "oh, my ankles have been a
bit swollen this week, probably the heat."
You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava, and I'm calling on behalf of the Zelvora Support Program. You started Zelvora about two weeks ago, and I just wanted to check in and see how you're getting on. Am I speaking with Maria?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Maria. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Besides the itching, have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright. Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming that. Do you have any questions about Zelvora that I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I don't have any questions. Oh, my ankles have been a bit swollen this week, probably the heat.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've passed that to the safety team. Is there anything else you'd like to know about Zelvora?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: My ankles have been a bit swollen this week, probably the heat.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks again for your time, Maria. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Take care, and goodbye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
